rows.label: MOO
rows.clue: The sound made by a cow or bull

rows.label: TOOT
rows.clue: A blast of a horn

rows.label: SIZZLE
rows.clue: A sizzling noise

rows.label: JOLT
rows.clue: A sudden jarring impact

rows.label: PLUMP
rows.clue: The sound of a sudden heavy fall

rows.label: BLIP
rows.clue: A sudden minor shock or meaningless interruption

rows.label: NEIGH
rows.clue: The characteristic sounds made by a horse

rows.label: CLIMBING
rows.clue: An event that involves rising to a higher point (as in altitude or temperature or intensity etc.)

rows.label: FLASH
rows.clue: A sudden intense burst of radiant energy

rows.label: QUAKE
rows.clue: Shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity

rows.label: QUAVER
rows.clue: A tremulous sound

rows.label: CREAK
rows.clue: A squeaking sound

rows.label: AIR WAVE
rows.clue: A sound wave that is transmitted via air

rows.label: DESCENT
rows.clue: A movement downward

rows.label: SETTLING
rows.clue: A gradual sinking to a lower level

rows.label: CLUMPING
rows.clue: The sound of a horse's hoofs hitting on a hard surface

rows.label: TING
rows.clue: A light clear metallic sound as of a small bell

rows.label: PULSE
rows.clue: (electronics) a sharp transient wave in the normal electrical state (or a series of such transients)

rows.label: ECLIPSE
rows.clue: One celestial body obscures another

rows.label: LONG JUMP
rows.clue: A competition that involves jumping as far as possible from a running start

rows.label: JUMP
rows.clue: A sudden and decisive increase

rows.label: BILLOW
rows.clue: A large sea wave

rows.label: STRIKING
rows.clue: The physical coming together of two or more things

rows.label: IMPACT
rows.clue: The striking of one body against another

rows.label: SUCCESS
rows.clue: An event that accomplishes its intended purpose

rows.label: GOLD RUSH
rows.clue: A sudden happening that brings good fortune (as a sudden opportunity to make money)

rows.label: STATIC
rows.clue: A crackling or hissing noise caused by electrical interference

rows.label: BLEND
rows.clue: An occurrence of thorough mixing

rows.label: PLOP
rows.clue: The noise of a rounded object dropping into a liquid without a splash

rows.label: ROLL
rows.clue: Rotary motion of an object around its own axis

rows.label: DISCUS
rows.clue: An athletic competition in which a disk-shaped object is thrown as far as possible

rows.label: FLICK
rows.clue: A light sharp contact (usually with something flexible)

rows.label: GENESIS
rows.clue: A coming into being

rows.label: RAVE
rows.clue: A dance party that lasts all night and electronically synthesized music is played

rows.label: PROM
rows.clue: A formal ball held for a school class toward the end of the academic year

rows.label: GLIMMER
rows.clue: A flash of light (especially reflected light)

rows.label: PRELUDE
rows.clue: Something that serves as a preceding event or introduces what follows

rows.label: REBOUND
rows.clue: A movement back from an impact

rows.label: DIN
rows.clue: A loud harsh or strident noise

rows.label: CAR RACE
rows.clue: A race between (usually high-performance) automobiles

rows.label: EASING
rows.clue: A change for the better

rows.label: FAINT
rows.clue: A spontaneous loss of consciousness caused by insufficient blood to the brain

rows.label: HEAD TRIP
rows.clue: An exciting or stimulating experience

rows.label: RAVAGE
rows.clue: (usually plural) a destructive action

rows.label: WRECKING
rows.clue: The event of a structure being completely demolished and leveled
